title: O lago de Lou
grammar: Yesterday, last night, last week com passado
goal: Use yesterday, last night e last week para dizer quando algo aconteceu.
reading: Lou was at the lake yesterday.
The weather was warm and sunny.
O tempo estava quente e ensolarado.
Last week it was cold and rainy.
Na semana passada estava frio e chuvoso.
Yesterday morning the lake was quiet.
Ontem de manhã o lago estava quieto.
Lou was alone, but he was happy.
Lou estava sozinho, mas estava feliz.
dialogue: No, it was only two days.
Were you there last night too?
Você também estava lá ontem à noite?
No, I was home last night.
Não, eu estava em casa ontem à noite.
pron: A força fica na primeira sílaba: YES-ter-day.
gram: Com was usamos yesterday; tomorrow é futuro.
